lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਖੋਟਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh khotee raas khotaa paasaaraa ||
lines.translation: The wealth of the self-willed manmukhs is false, and false is their ostentatious display.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kamaavan dukh laagai bhaaraa ||
lines.translation: They practice falsehood, and suffer terrible pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: bharame bhoole phiran din raatee mar janamahi janam gavaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: Deluded by doubt, they wander day and night; through birth and death, they lose their lives. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੈ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib mai at piaaraa ||
lines.translation: My True Lord and Master is very dear to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: poore gur kai sabad adhaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Shabad of the Perfect Guru is my Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee dukh sukh sam kar jaananiaa ||8||10||11||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who obtains the Greatness of the Naam, looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same. ||8||10||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tereeaa khaanee tereeaa baanee ||
lines.translation: The four sources of creation are Yours; the spoken word is Yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh bharam bhulaanee ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, all are deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te har naam paaiaa bin satigur koi na paavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained. Without the True Guru, no one can receive it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree har setee chit laavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sachaa gur bhagatee paaeeai sahaje ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Through devotion to the Guru, the True One is found; He comes to abide in the mind, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve taa sabh kichh paae ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, all things are obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jehee manasaa kar laagai tehaa phal paae ||
lines.translation: As are the desires one harbors, so are the rewards one receives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਥੂ ਕਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur daataa sabhanaa vathoo kaa poorai bhaag milaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of all things; through perfect destiny, He is met. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਇਕੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man mailaa ik na dhiaae ||
lines.translation: This mind is filthy and polluted; it does not meditate on the One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar mail laagee bahu doojai bhaae ||
lines.translation: Deep within, it is soiled and stained by the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਭਵੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਵਧੇਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tat teerath disa(n)tar bhavai aha(n)kaaree hor vadherai haumai mal laavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: The egotists may go on pilgrimages to holy rivers, sacred shrines and foreign lands, but they only gather more of the dirt of egotism. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seve taa mal jaae ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, filth and pollution are removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai har siu chit laae ||
lines.translation: Those who focus their consciousness on the Lord remain dead while yet alive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: har niramal sach mail na laagai sach laagai mail gavaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: The True Lord is Pure; no filth sticks to Him. Those who are attached to the True One have their filth washed away. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baajh guroo hai a(n)dh gubaaraa ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: agiaanee a(n)dhaa a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||
lines.translation: The ignorant ones are blind-there is only utter darkness for them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bisataa ke keeRe bisataa kamaavahi phir bisataa maahi pachaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: The maggots in manure do filthy deeds, and in filth they rot and putrefy. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukate seve mukataa hovai ||
lines.translation: Serving the Lord of Liberation, liberation is achieved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai mamataa sabade khovai ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Shabad eradicates egotism and possessiveness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: anadin har jeeu sachaa sevee poorai bhaag gur paavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: So serve the Dear True Lord, night and day. By perfect good destiny, the Guru is found. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhase mel milaae ||
lines.translation: He Himself forgives and unites in His Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: poore gur te naam nidh paae ||
lines.translation: From the Perfect Guru, the Treasure of the Naam is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sachai naam sadaa man sachaa sach seve dukh gavaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: By the True Name, the mind is made true forever. Serving the True Lord, sorrow is driven out. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa hajoor door na jaanahu ||
lines.translation: He is always close at hand-do not think that He is far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee har a(n)tar pachhaanahu ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Lord deep within your own being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੧॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee poore gur te paavaniaa ||8||11||12||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, glorious greatness is received. Through the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained. ||8||11||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aithai saache s aagai saache ||
lines.translation: Those who are True here, are True hereafter as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਚੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man sachaa sachai sabad raache ||
lines.translation: That mind is true, which is attuned to the True Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa sevahi sach kamaavahi sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: They serve the True One, and practice Truth; they earn Truth, and only Truth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree sachaa naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sache sevahi sach samaavahi sache ke gun gaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: They serve the True One, and are absorbed into the True One, singing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit paRahi saad na paavahi ||
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars read, but they do not taste the essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਭਰਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai maaiaa man bharamaavahi ||
lines.translation: In love with duality and Maya, their minds wander, unfocused.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਭ ਸੁਧਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohi sabh sudh gavaaee kar avagan pachhotaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: The love of Maya has displaced all their understanding; making mistakes, they live in regret. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਤਤੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur milai taa tat paae ||
lines.translation: But if they should meet the True Guru, then they obtain the essence of reality;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaae ||
lines.translation: the Name of the Lord comes to dwell in their minds.
